main_text.p: XIII. Atque haec est triplex scala perquam Philosophus a quolibet ente creato, ejusve modo & gradu potest ac debet, ad Deum adscendere; Cui utilissime additur demonstratio ab aequalibus, qua ab una adeoq; qualibet perfectione divina mens nostra deducitur ad quamlibet aliam, & haec est firmissima demonstratio. Nos autem imposterum vel omnes vel pleraque vias conjungemus, imprimis dabimus operam, ut ex eo quod sit Ens non factum adeo-q; ex primo termino Ens omnes demonstren-tur.[illegible, ~6 letters][illegible, ~3 letters][illegible, ~7 letters][illegible, ~6 letters][illegible, ~8 letters][illegible, ~5 letters][illegible, ~5 letters][illegible, ~3 letters][illegible, ~6 letters][illegible, ~4 letters]
main_text.head: CAP. VI. De Demonstratione propri-etatum seu attributorum Dei quate-nus est Ens primum.
main_text.p: S[illegible, ~3 letters]ic se habent præcognita demonstrationis, se-quitur ipsa demonstratio, ubi observandum est duplicem posse adhiberi methodum, alia enim est via inventionis, alia Explicationis, illa est præmittenda huic, illa ostendit, quod sint attributa Dei, hæc quid sint: Proprietatis & attri-butinomen hic indifferenter usurpabitur,

page.notes: The left margin is cropped by the page edge; the marginal fragments there (roughly ten lines above the heading and about eleven below it) are unreadable, so each is marked as illegible with an estimated letter count. The first printed word of the chapter paragraph is a large initial "S" joined to "ic". The catchword "idq;" sits at the lower right below the last line and is not repeated in the text. The "attributi" hyphenation at the line end ("at-tributi") was joined as printed. The "[illegible]" foot note below the text is a short marginal-type line at the foot and could not be read.
